description: NoVA Bicycle Infrastructure Network Atlas (Keystone GIS Day 65) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Keystone GIS (Keystone GIS Northern Virginia GIS Research Program). Every mapped physical bicycle facility in Northern Virginia - 1,625 km across 8,937 segments - classified by protection level, scored for network connectivity, and joined to tract-level bike commuting. Derived from OpenStreetMap, cross-verified against the VDOT Bicycle Facility Inventory (0.6 percent regional agreement) and Arlington County GIS. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
